cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from engine import project

rng = random.Random(99)
bad = 0
for trial in range(3000):
    U = rng.choice([5, 17, 100, 2**31-1])
    nold = rng.randint(1, 8)
    nnew = rng.randint(1, 8)
    def borders(n):
        cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, U), n-1)) if n > 1 else []
        return [0] + cuts + [U]
    old, new = borders(nold), borders(nnew)
    vals = [rng.randint(-5, 40) for _ in range(nold)]   # history can be anything
    out = project(old, vals, new, nnew)
    if sum(out) != sum(vals):
        bad += 1
        print('total not preserved', old, vals, new, out)
    # non-negative masses behave too
    vals2 = [rng.randint(0, 40) for _ in range(nold)]
    out2 = project(old, vals2, new, nnew)
    assert all(x >= 0 for x in out2), (old, vals2, new, out2)
    assert sum(out2) == sum(vals2)
    # old range count 1 -> identity when the partition is the same
    if nold == nnew == 1:
        assert project([0, U], [7], [0, U], 1) == [7]
print('projection invariant failures:', bad)

# reference formula check against a direct reading of the protocol text
def ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v):
    cl = lambda x: max(0, min(x, c-b))
    return (m*cl(v-b))//(c-b) - (m*cl(u-b))//(c-b)
for trial in range(500):
    U = rng.randint(2, 200)
    b = rng.randint(0, U-1); c = rng.randint(b+1, U)
    u = rng.randint(0, U-1); v = rng.randint(u+1, U)
    m = rng.randint(0, 1000)
    old = [0, b, c, U] if (b > 0 and c < U) else None
    if old is None: continue
    vals = [0, m, 0]
    out = project(old, vals, [0, u, v, U], 3)
    assert out[1] == ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v), (m,b,c,u,v,out)
print('projection matches the literal formula')
EOF
